entries.title: PostReady: PR #914 — Cut onboarding from six screens to two
entries.description: Onboarding flow condensed from six screens to two, dramatically reducing friction for new users getting started with PostReady.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #913 — Carousel Builder three-column redesign
entries.description: Carousel Builder workspace redesigned to a three-column layout, improving editorial flow and giving creators more space to work with cards and settings side by side.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #912 — Point every customer-facing address at the one monitored inbox
entries.description: All customer-facing email addresses now route to the single monitored inbox, ensuring no customer communication is missed.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #911 — Daily operations brief to info@zippityone.com
entries.description: Automated daily operations brief email delivered to the primary business inbox — keeps Pete informed of platform activity without requiring manual dashboard checks.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #910 — Admin alerts routed to correct email address
entries.description: Admin alert emails now route to the address Pete actually reads, ensuring critical system notifications reach him reliably.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #909 — Coach user on page checklist sends them to
entries.description: After the activation checklist guides new users to a key page, contextual coaching copy now explains what to do there — reducing drop-off in the onboarding flow.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #908 — Activation checklist + first-post celebration
entries.description: New user activation flow: setup checklist guides first-time users through key steps, with a celebration moment on first post to improve activation rates.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #906 — Fix constraint that silently locked out every paying customer
entries.description: Critical hotfix: removed the data constraint that was silently preventing every paying customer from accessing their PostReady account.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #903 — Show which platforms can't publish yet
entries.description: Connect Socials page now surfaces platforms that are connected but not yet live for publishing, reducing user confusion during API approval period.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #902 — Introductory pricing replaces 7-day free trial
entries.description: Pricing page switched from free-trial model to introductory pricing, aligning with single-plan positioning.
